instruction: Make the task pane on the right visible to access slide layout options and properties.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=12, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to show the task pane (right side panel) in LibreOffice Impress. The config hides it using View menu navigation (F10 -> right 2x -> down 12x -> enter). The evaluator checks if 'Tasks' is present in the accessibility tree by searching through panel, tool-bar, scroll-pane, or filler elements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly handles expected parameter (directly accesses expected.get('panel_name') without looking for expected.get('rules'))
Semantic logic is correct: searches for 'Tasks' panel in accessibility tree to verify task pane visibility
Complete coverage: instruction asks to enable task pane, evaluator checks for Tasks panel presence
Appropriate getter: get_accessibility_tree is correct for checking UI element visibility in LibreOffice Impress
Expected value is correct: 'Tasks' is the actual name of the task pane in LibreOffice Impress
Robust search strategy: searches multiple element types (panel, tool-bar, scroll-pane, filler) with substring matching
Proper error handling: try-except block handles XML parsing errors appropriately
